source_units.text: Write a silent-film scene using visible actions.
These invented details are required: The scene shows a person hanging an empty picture frame, noticing a passing cloud through its open center, and repositioning it until the cloud is framed.
End with the person bows to the wall.
Include each of these exact strings: "an empty picture frame", "a passing cloud", "bows to the wall".
The full text must be between 60 and 90 words.
